why: Alias rows deliberately removed from retrieval by duplicate election. The row, its id and its text are KEPT (CLAUDE.md section 10 — nothing is deleted); only `embedding` is NULLed, so the row stops being a Path B candidate. This file is the DURABLE half: `db:embed:skills` seeds its blocked-id list from here, so neither a routine backfill nor `--reset-embeddings` can silently re-embed a row that was de-elected on purpose.
